n: Tommy the Die-Hard and the Losers
d: A bulky, heavy-set build wearing a red and charcoal grey tactical combat suit consisting of a red undershirt, a grey padded ballistic vest with red accents and pouches, and grey armored trousers with black plating. The head is fully enclosed in a red and black helmet with a dark visor that glows with bright cyan light from the eye slits, obscuring the face and age. A large, vertical black rectangular riot shield is held in the right hand, and the left arm features a grey armored gauntlet with a glowing cyan circular detail on the upper arm.
